|lore=A user of the Force can subjugate the will of others or alter the environment at a distance, as when Vader 'disciplines' those whose lack of faith disturbs him.
|game_text=Cancel one [[Effect]] (or [[Utinni Effect]]) by drawing a destiny &lt; ability of your highest-ability character on table. OR Cancel one [[Sense]] card just played.
|joke=The quotation marks around "disciplines" stand for Darth Vader's Force choke: in ''Star Wars'' he chokes Admiral Motti, whose "lack of faith" he finds "disturbing".<ref name="imsdb-anh">[https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-A-New-Hope.html Star Wars: A New Hope script], IMSDb. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260720032511/https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-A-New-Hope.html Internet Archive], 20 July 2026.</ref> It is part of the running gag of cards where Vader chokes his own officers.
